  <header class="story-heading">
    <p class="story-kicker">COUNTRY-YEAR ANALYSIS</p>
    <h1>How Do Behavioral Factors Predict Cardiovascular Disease Worldwide?</h1>
    <p>
      Each dot is one country-year observation comparing WHO tobacco-use prevalence with age-standardized cardiovascular mortality. The dataset contains 1,902 matched observations across 98 countries from 2000 to 2023.
    </p>
  </header>

  <section class="story-section" aria-labelledby="predictor-plot-heading">
    <div class="story-section-heading">
      <div>
        <p class="story-kicker">EXPLORATORY MODEL</p>
        <h2 id="predictor-plot-heading">Tobacco prevalence and CVD mortality</h2>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scatter-card">
      <div class="scatter-controls">
        <div class="scatter-field">
          <label for="yearSelect">Year</label>
          <select id="yearSelect"></select>
        </div>
        <div class="scatter-field">
            <label for="regionSelect">WHO region</label>
          <select id="regionSelect">
              <option value="All WHO regions">All WHO regions</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="scatter-field">
          <label for="countrySelect">Country</label>
          <select id="countrySelect">
            <option value="All countries">All countries</option>

      <div class="axis-summary">
        <div><strong>Y-axis:</strong> CVD mortality rate (per 100,000)</div>
        <div><strong>X-axis:</strong> Tobacco-use prevalence (%)</div>

      <div class="regression-stats" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Regression statistics">
        <div><span>Observations (n)</span><strong id="statN">Loading</strong></div>
        <div><span>Correlation (r)</span><strong id="statR">-</strong></div>
        <div><span>R-squared</span><strong id="statR2">-</strong></div>
        <div><span>OLS equation</span><strong id="statEquation">-</strong></div>
      </div>

      <p class="data-source-note">Dots are colored by WHO region. Hover over a dot to see whether its tobacco value is a WHO estimate or a linear interpolation between WHO estimate years. No tobacco values are extrapolated beyond the available WHO years.</p>

      <div class="scatter-plot-wrap">
        <svg id="cvdScatter" viewBox="0 0 900 500" role="img" aria-label="Scatter plot of tobacco-use prevalence and age-standardized cardiovascular mortality by country-year, with an ordinary least-squares trendline"></svg>
        <div id="scatterTooltip" class="scatter-tooltip" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
  (function () {
    const regionColors = {
      Africa: '#1d4e89',
      Americas: '#2a9d8f',
      'Eastern Mediterranean': '#e76f51',
      Europe: '#f4a261',
      'South-East Asia': '#6a4c93',
      'Western Pacific': '#168aad'
    };

    const svg = document.getElementById('cvdScatter');
    const yearSelect = document.getElementById('yearSelect');
    const regionSelect = document.getElementById('regionSelect');
    const countrySelect = document.getElementById('countrySelect');
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('scatterTooltip');
    const statN = document.getElementById('statN');
    const statR = document.getElementById('statR');
    const statR2 = document.getElementById('statR2');
    const statEquation = document.getElementById('statEquation');

    let data = [];

    function parseCSV(text) {
      const rows = [];
      let row = [];
      let field = '';
      let quoted = false;

      for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
        const character = text[index];
        if (quoted && character === '"' && text[index + 1] === '"') {
          field += '"';
          index += 1;
        } else if (character === '"') {
          quoted = !quoted;
        } else if (!quoted && character === ',') {
          row.push(field);
          field = '';
        } else if (!quoted && character === '\n') {
          row.push(field.replace(/\r$/, ''));
          rows.push(row);
          row = [];
          field = '';
        } else {
          field += character;
        }
      }
      if (field || row.length) {
        row.push(field.replace(/\r$/, ''));
        rows.push(row);
      }

      const header = rows.shift() || [];
      return rows.filter((values) => values.length === header.length).map((values) => {
        const obj = Object.fromEntries(header.map((key, index) => [key.trim(), values[index]?.trim()]));
        return {
          Country: obj.Country,
          Code: obj.Code,
          Year: Number(obj.Year),
          Region: obj.WHORegion,
          Tobacco: Number(obj.Tobacco),
          CVDMortality: Number(obj.CVDMortality),
          TobaccoMethod: obj.TobaccoMethod
        };
      });
    }

    function populateControl(select, values, placeholder) {
      select.innerHTML = '';
      const placeholderOption = document.createElement('option');
      placeholderOption.value = placeholder;
      placeholderOption.textContent = placeholder;
      select.appendChild(placeholderOption);
      values.forEach((value) => {
        const option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = String(value);
        option.textContent = String(value);
        select.appendChild(option);
      });
    }

    function updateControls() {
      const years = [...new Set(data.map((d) => d.Year))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      populateControl(yearSelect, years, 'All years');
      yearSelect.value = 'All years';

      const regions = [...new Set(data.map((d) => d.Region))].sort();
      populateControl(regionSelect, regions, 'All WHO regions');
      regionSelect.value = 'All WHO regions';

      const countries = [...new Set(data.map((d) => d.Country))].sort();
      populateControl(countrySelect, countries, 'All countries');
      countrySelect.value = 'All countries';
    }

    function getFilteredData() {
      const selectedYear = yearSelect.value;
      const selectedRegion = regionSelect.value;
      const selectedCountry = countrySelect.value;

      return data.filter((d) => {
        const yearMatch = selectedYear === 'All years' || Number(selectedYear) === d.Year;
        const regionMatch = selectedRegion === 'All WHO regions' || d.Region === selectedRegion;
        const countryMatch = selectedCountry === 'All countries' || d.Country === selectedCountry;
        return yearMatch && regionMatch && countryMatch && Number.isFinite(d.Tobacco) && Number.isFinite(d.CVDMortality);
      });
    }

    function showTooltip(event, row, xValue, yValue) {
      tooltip.innerHTML = `
        <strong>${row.Country}</strong>
        ${row.Region}<br>
        Year: ${row.Year}<br>
        Tobacco use: ${xValue.toFixed(2)}%<br>
        CVD mortality: ${yValue.toFixed(1)} per 100,000<br>
        Tobacco value: ${row.TobaccoMethod}
      `;
      tooltip.style.display = 'block';
      tooltip.style.left = `${(event.clientX ?? 0) + 14}px`;
      tooltip.style.top = `${(event.clientY ?? 0) + 14}px`;
    }

    function hideTooltip() {
      tooltip.style.display = 'none';
    }

    function calculateRegression(rows) {
      if (rows.length < 2) return null;
      const meanX = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.Tobacco, 0) / rows.length;
      const meanY = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.CVDMortality, 0) / rows.length;
      const sxx = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.Tobacco - meanX) ** 2, 0);
      const syy = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.CVDMortality - meanY) ** 2, 0);
      const sxy = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.Tobacco - meanX) * (row.CVDMortality - meanY), 0);
      if (!sxx || !syy) return null;
      const slope = sxy / sxx;
      return { slope, intercept: meanY - slope * meanX, r: sxy / Math.sqrt(sxx * syy) };
    }

    function updateRegressionStats(rows, regression) {
      statN.textContent = rows.length.toLocaleString();
      statR.textContent = regression ? regression.r.toFixed(3) : '-';
      statR2.textContent = regression ? (regression.r ** 2).toFixed(3) : '-';
      statEquation.textContent = regression
        ? `CVD = ${regression.intercept.toFixed(2)} + ${regression.slope.toFixed(2)}x`
        : '-';
    }

    function renderChart() {
      const filtered = getFilteredData();
      const regression = calculateRegression(filtered);
      updateRegressionStats(filtered, regression);
      const width = 900;
      const height = 500;
      const margin = { top: 20, right: 25, bottom: 60, left: 75 };
      const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;

      svg.innerHTML = '';

      if (!filtered.length) {
        const text = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
        text.setAttribute('x', width / 2);
        text.setAttribute('y', height / 2);
        text.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
        text.setAttribute('fill', '#425468');
        text.setAttribute('font-size', '16');
        text.textContent = 'No observations match the current filters.';
        svg.appendChild(text);
        return;
      }

      const xMin = Math.min(...filtered.map((d) => d.Tobacco));
      const xMax = Math.max(...filtered.map((d) => d.Tobacco));
      const predicted = regression
        ? [regression.intercept + regression.slope * xMin, regression.intercept + regression.slope * xMax]
        : [];
      const yMin = Math.min(0, ...predicted);
      const yMax = Math.max(...filtered.map((d) => d.CVDMortality), ...predicted, 1) * 1.08;

      const xScale = (value) => margin.left + ((value - xMin) / Math.max(xMax - xMin, 1e-6)) * innerWidth;
      const yScale = (value) => height - margin.bottom - ((value - yMin) / Math.max(yMax - yMin, 1e-6)) * innerHeight;

      const axisGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      const xAxis = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
      xAxis.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-axis');
      xAxis.setAttribute('x1', margin.left);
      xAxis.setAttribute('x2', width - margin.right);
      xAxis.setAttribute('y1', height - margin.bottom);
      xAxis.setAttribute('y2', height - margin.bottom);
      axisGroup.appendChild(xAxis);

      const yAxis = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
      yAxis.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-axis');
      yAxis.setAttribute('x1', margin.left);
      yAxis.setAttribute('x2', margin.left);
      yAxis.setAttribute('y1', margin.top);
      yAxis.setAttribute('y2', height - margin.bottom);
      axisGroup.appendChild(yAxis);

      for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i += 1) {
        const yTickValue = yMin + ((yMax - yMin) / 5) * i;
        const xGrid = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
        xGrid.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-grid');
        xGrid.setAttribute('x1', margin.left);
        xGrid.setAttribute('x2', width - margin.right);
        xGrid.setAttribute('y1', yScale(yTickValue));
        xGrid.setAttribute('y2', yScale(yTickValue));
        axisGroup.appendChild(xGrid);

        const yLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
        yLabel.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-label');
        yLabel.setAttribute('x', margin.left - 12);
        yLabel.setAttribute('y', yScale(yTickValue) + 4);
        yLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'end');
        yLabel.textContent = Math.round(yTickValue);
        axisGroup.appendChild(yLabel);
      }

      for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i += 1) {
        const xTickValue = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) / 5) * i;
        const yGrid = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
        yGrid.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-grid');
        yGrid.setAttribute('x1', xScale(xTickValue));
        yGrid.setAttribute('x2', xScale(xTickValue));
        yGrid.setAttribute('y1', margin.top);
        yGrid.setAttribute('y2', height - margin.bottom);
        axisGroup.appendChild(yGrid);

        const xLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
        xLabel.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-label');
        xLabel.setAttribute('x', xScale(xTickValue));
        xLabel.setAttribute('y', height - margin.bottom + 20);
        xLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
        xLabel.textContent = Number(xTickValue).toFixed(0);
        axisGroup.appendChild(xLabel);
      }

      const xAxisLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      xAxisLabel.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-label');
      xAxisLabel.setAttribute('x', width / 2);
      xAxisLabel.setAttribute('y', height - 10);
      xAxisLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
      xAxisLabel.textContent = 'Tobacco-use prevalence (%)';
      axisGroup.appendChild(xAxisLabel);

      const yAxisLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-label');
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('x', -height / 2);
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('y', 18);
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
      yAxisLabel.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(-90)');
      yAxisLabel.textContent = 'CVD mortality rate (per 100,000)';
      axisGroup.appendChild(yAxisLabel);
      svg.appendChild(axisGroup);

      if (regression) {
        const trendline = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
        trendline.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-trendline');
        trendline.setAttribute('x1', xScale(xMin));
        trendline.setAttribute('x2', xScale(xMax));
        trendline.setAttribute('y1', yScale(regression.intercept + regression.slope * xMin));
        trendline.setAttribute('y2', yScale(regression.intercept + regression.slope * xMax));
        svg.appendChild(trendline);
      }

      filtered.forEach((row) => {
        const circle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
        const xValue = row.Tobacco;
        const yValue = row.CVDMortality;
        circle.setAttribute('class', 'scatter-dot');
        circle.setAttribute('cx', xScale(xValue));
        circle.setAttribute('cy', yScale(yValue));
        circle.setAttribute('r', 4.8);
        circle.setAttribute('fill', regionColors[row.Region] || '#3d8ad6');
        circle.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        circle.setAttribute('aria-label', `${row.Country}, ${row.Year}: tobacco use ${xValue.toFixed(2)} percent, CVD mortality ${yValue.toFixed(1)} per 100,000, ${row.TobaccoMethod}`);
        circle.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => showTooltip(event, row, xValue, yValue));
        circle.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
        circle.addEventListener('focus', (event) => showTooltip(event, row, xValue, yValue));
        circle.addEventListener('blur', hideTooltip);
        svg.appendChild(circle);
      });
    }

    yearSelect.addEventListener('change', renderChart);
    regionSelect.addEventListener('change', renderChart);
    countrySelect.addEventListener('change', renderChart);

    fetch('data/cvd_tobacco_country_year_data.csv')
      .then((response) => response.text())
      .then((text) => {
        data = parseCSV(text);
        updateControls();
        renderChart();
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        console.error('Scatter plot data could not be loaded:', error);
        svg.innerHTML = '<text x="450" y="250" text-anchor="middle" fill="#425468" font-size="16">Data failed to load.</text>';
      });
  })();
</script>
```
